name.tooLong: The name is longer than {{max}} characters
name.masked: The name looks like hidden data, for example a card number: such a value is not saved

id.format: ID: lowercase Latin letters, digits and hyphens, up to 32 characters
id.digitsProject: A project ID cannot be digits only: the order of such a record would not be preserved
id.digitsEnvironment: An environment ID cannot be digits only: the order of such a record would not be preserved
id.reservedProject: ID “{{id}}” is taken by a page address: choose another

label.format: Label name: Latin letters, digits and underscores
label.reserved: Labels starting with two underscores are internal: the form does not accept them

value.tooLong: The value is longer than {{max}} characters
value.edgeSpace: Space at the edge of the value: this is almost always a typo and gives an empty result
value.regex: The regular expression does not suit the log storage: check brackets, escapes and that it has no lookahead or back-references

store.unknown: Log storage “{{store}}” is not in the settings file. Known: {{known}}

example.tooMany: An environment has at most {{max}} search examples
example.labelEmpty: The example caption cannot be empty
example.labelTooLong: The example caption is longer than {{max}} characters
example.labelControl: The example caption has control characters
example.labelMasked: The caption looks like hidden data, for example a card number: put the value in values
example.tooManyValues: An example has at most {{max}} values, like the search bar
example.needLong: At least one value of the example must be {{min}} characters or longer, like in the search bar
example.valueSeparator: A comma, tab or line break splits values in the search bar: write each value as its own list item
example.valueShort: The value is shorter than {{min}} characters
example.valueLong: The value is longer than {{max}} characters
example.valueChar: The value has a quotation mark or a backslash: the search bar does not accept them

selector.tooMany: No more than {{max}} conditions in an environment
selector.twoEqualities: Two different equalities on label {{label}}: such an environment is always empty
selector.noEquality: Environment “{{id}}” needs at least one equality condition (op: "=") with a non-empty value, so that logs outside the project are not read

stand.missing: Stands environment “{{id}}” has no stand field with a label and template
stand.placeholder: A stand template must have exactly one place for the number {number}, for example pr-{number}
stand.templateChars: A stand template may contain Latin letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores
stand.onlyForStands: The stand field exists only in a stands environment (kind: pr-stands)
stand.noConstant: The stand template has no constant part: it would read any numeric value of the label

scope.none: The form does not save conditions for log storage “{{store}}” until a boundary is set in the settings file: an administrator adds backends.{{store}}.formScope, for example formScope: { label: namespace, values: [acme, 'acme-*'] }
scope.value: Value outside the log storage boundary: allowed {{values}} ({{where}})
scope.template: Stand template outside the log storage boundary: allowed {{values}} ({{where}})
scope.equality: An equality condition on label {{label}} is needed: allowed {{values}} ({{where}})

project.timezone: Unknown time zone: a name from the time zone database is needed, for example Europe/Berlin
project.retention: Retention: a whole number of days from 1 to 400
project.format: Log format “{{format}}” does not exist. Known formats: {{known}}
project.noEnvironments: At least one environment is needed
project.tooManyEnvironments: No more than {{max}} environments in a project
project.notInFile: The project is not in the settings file
project.confirmMismatch: The confirmation does not match the project ID

logo.notBase64: A logo is accepted only as file contents in base64, not as an address
logo.tooBig: The file is over the {{max}} KB limit
logo.lightRequired: The light version of the logo is required
logo.noPrevious: There is no previous version of the logo
logo.fileTooBig: The file is {{size}} KB, over the {{max}} KB limit
logo.pngSignature: The file does not start with a PNG signature
logo.pngNoHeader: The PNG file has no block with the image size
logo.pngZeroSize: The PNG file has a zero image size
logo.pngTooLarge: The PNG file size {{width}}×{{height}} is over the {{max}} pixel limit
logo.svgEncoding: The SVG file is not in UTF-8 encoding
logo.svgRoot: The root element of the file is not <svg
logo.svgNotClosed: The SVG file has no closing </svg>
logo.svgActive: The SVG file has active content: {{name}}
logo.svgHandler: The SVG file has active content: event handler on…=
logo.svgDoctype: The SVG file has active content: <!DOCTYPE with an internal subset
logo.svgEntity: The SVG file has active content: numeric entity in an attribute
logo.svgHref: The SVG file has an external href link
logo.svgUrl: The SVG file has an external url() link
logo.svgNoSize: The root of the SVG file has no numeric width and height or viewBox, or they are zero: the proportions cannot be determined

masking.fieldFormat: Field name: 1 to 64 characters, Latin letters, digits, “_”, “.”, “:” and “-”
masking.fieldDuplicate: This field is already in the list
masking.fieldTaken: This field already belongs to the type “{{type}}”
masking.kindLocked: This type has no switch: it cannot be turned off

view.alwaysOn: This element cannot be turned off
view.rawOnly: An unrecognized record is visible only in raw records
view.defaultTabOff: The default tab is off in both modes

catalog.systemHidden: The system is hidden: restore it to add and edit its entries
catalog.methodHidden: The method is hidden: restore it to add and edit its entries
catalog.maskingAdminOnly: Only an administrator can change the masking section: the file was not applied
catalog.settingsNoRight: Only an analyst or an administrator can change the settings section: the file was not applied
catalog.settingsNoRecord: The project has no record in the database yet: the settings section has nothing to apply to
catalog.settingsInSeed: The initial set does not change settings: the settings section was skipped, the rest was applied. Settings are changed on the “Project file” page
catalog.maskingInSeed: The initial set does not change masking: the masking section was skipped, the rest was applied. An administrator changes masking on the “Project file” page
catalog.rpcOnEntry: Actions are not read on a request into the project: this method will not match there. Keep one method without rpc on this address
catalog.queueNoSteps: Threadline finds no separate message bus steps in the logs: the system shows in the catalog and on HTTP calls to its host. If this is an HTTP service, remove type
catalog.outcomeNoResponse: Outcome rules are checked only on HTTP responses: database and message bus records have no response, so this rule will not match. Remove it
catalog.errorHttpOnDatabase: A database record has no HTTP status: a rule with this condition will not match. Remove http
catalog.generalHttpOnly: One HTTP status is not enough for a general rule: every such error in the project would get this text. Add text or code
catalog.textHidden: The substring has a hidden part, “…” or asterisks: the error text does not have it, so the rule will not match. Keep only the constant part
catalog.entityNotShown: Types of kind entity ({{types}}) are not shown on the request and operation pages: they are visible only in the “Identifiers” section. If you need the “Open operation” button, set kind: operation. Otherwise nothing needs doing
catalog.duplicateField: The field is repeated: the last value applies. Keep one
